check_events.outcome: Conditional pointed-lift criterion checked for a connected groupoid cover. Let D be connected, G=Aut_D(x0), H the image of the pointed covering group, and Theta an automorphism fixing x0. Write alpha=Theta|G. In the path model, the fiber over x is Hom_D(x0,x)/H. If alpha(H)=H, the rule [t]↦[Theta(t)] is well defined and invertible and commutes with all lifted arrows; it fixes the distinguished [1]. Conversely any pointed lift sends the loop stabilizer H to itself, so alpha(H)=H. Its values are forced by lifted paths from [1], giving uniqueness. This verifies the abstract groupoid assertion with stability understood as equality. It does not prove the geometric cover equivalence. Restriction of Theta to each fixed torsor Hom(x0,xi) additionally requires Theta(xi)=xi; fixing x0 alone does not supply that hypothesis.
